source_citation: Wu, Du, Qian, Cheng, Wang, Zhang and Peng (2020), Structure and Seasonal Variation of the Indian Ocean Tropical Gyre Based on Surface Drifters, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans, doi:10.1029/2019JC015483.
source_locator: Sections 2.1-2.2: drifter support, 1993-2018 selection, fitted seasonal fields and December-March winter. Section 3 seasonal discussion after Figures 5-6: eastward SECC reaches about 90 E before recirculating into SEC; Figure 13 caption.
source_access: Full publisher sections 2 and relevant section 3 seasonal discussion, Figure 5/13 captions and Conclusion inspected. No figure digitized, fitted field acquired or source trajectories traced.
scope: Declared 50-90 E eastward winter surface reach. The 50 E start is an OSW offshore truncation beyond the western confluence, and 90 E follows approximate recirculation context. Neither is a diagnosed whole-current terminus. Excludes Somali/East African source legs, the southern return into SEC, South Java continuation, equatorial Wyrtki jets and subsurface SEUC.
layer: Surface drifter climatology with GDP drogue support near 15 m and wind-slip-corrected undrogued observations; not a uniform fixed-depth current axis or full vertical extent. OSCAR upper-layer and deeper current diagnostics remain separate.
time_convention: Source boreal winter December-March convention; Gauss-Markov seasonal climatology using 1993-2018 drifter context. Not a dated trajectory or complete annual route series.

sampling_context.source_figure_2_sampling_start_discrepan: Data selection states 1993 while Figure 2 caption states 1995; retained as unresolved source description.

width_source_review.citation: Huang et al. (2023), Meridional-Width Variability of Near-Equatorial Zonal Currents Along 80.5 E on Seasonal to Interannual Timescales in the Indian Ocean, doi:10.1029/2022JC019147.
width_source_review.access: Full publisher Introduction, sections 2.1/2.3/2.4/3.1 and Figure 2 caption inspected; no data/contours acquired.
width_source_review.locator: Section 3.1 and Figure 2; OSCAR definition in 2.1.
width_source_review.ORAS5_text_caption_depth_conflict: Methods says upper 30 m; Figure 2 caption says 0-40 m. No common fixed-depth width assigned.
